# Topflight Apps

> California-based healthcare app development and AI consultancy partner specializing in HIPAA-compliant solutions, EHR integration, and rapid MVP prototyping for health tech founders.

Topflight Apps combines expert product design with healthcare compliance expertise to help founders launch digital health solutions. The team has supported clients in raising over $165M in funding across healthcare, fintech, and ecommerce sectors.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA compliance
- EHR integration
- Healthcare app development
- Generative AI
- MVP development
- Rapid prototyping
- Medical coding
- Telehealth
- Epic integration
- FHIR API
- Digital health
- Computer vision
- Clinical decision support
- Product launch
- Agile methodology

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Healthcare App Development](https://topflightapps.com/healthcare/healthcare-app-developer): Award-winning healthcare app development with HIPAA compliance, EHR integration, and telehealth solutions.
- [Fast Track Rapid Prototyping](https://topflightapps.com/fast-track-rapid-prototyping): Fast-Track MVP Prototype service for healthcare founders with 2-week delivery.
- [AI-Accelerated Rapid Prototyping](https://topflightapps.com/mobile-app-prototyping-services): AI-accelerated prototyping service for HIPAA-compliant healthcare MVPs in weeks.
- [EHR Integration Services](https://topflightapps.com/ehr-integration): EHR integration partner for Epic, FHIR API, and healthcare workflow automation.
- [Generative AI in Healthcare](https://topflightapps.com/generative-ai): Generative AI solutions for medical coding, clinical decision support, and healthcare workflows.
- [Vibe to Traction System](https://topflightapps.com/vibe-to-traction-system): 5-step system converting vibe-coded prototypes to compliant healthcare products.

## Case Studies & Portfolio

- [Case Studies](https://topflightapps.com/portfolio): Portfolio of case studies: Medable, Tula Health, Stellarheath, and other healthcare apps.
- [GaleAI: Medical Coding Platform](https://topflightapps.com/portfolio/galeai-medical-coding): Case study: GaleAI AI platform for faster, cheaper medical coding and billing automation.
- [Allheartz: Computer Vision in Physiotherapy](https://topflightapps.com/portfolio/allheartz-computer-vision-rtm-app): Case study: Allheartz RTM platform using computer vision for physiotherapy monitoring.
- [iFaint: Medical Study App](https://topflightapps.com/portfolio/ifaint): Case study: iFaint HIPAA-compliant medical study app with wearable data integration.
